ranking_rule: strongest measured channel, then reaction id; repeated channels take max; not calibrated probabilities
assignment_assumption: one target-alone catalytic clause per reaction; alternative EC mappings are separate hypotheses; joint multifunction and supported complex clauses require an explicit manifest
excluded_sources: target GPR, model gene annotations, reactions.tsv, final integration probabilities, FBA and learned/inferred claims; no function is inferred from a gene identifier
interpretation: conditional comparisons; no function recovery, calibrated probability or promotion
